lines.t: Good morning, friends! I am Rayo! Today I visit the big railway station!
Look, the ticket window! One little ticket for me, please!
The long platform is so busy! I zoom to my spot! Vroom!
Here comes the big red steam train! Choo choo!
Bye bye, kind conductor! See you at the next station!
Into the dark tunnel! My headlights shine so bright!
The signal light turned green! Go go go!
Over the tall bridge we go, above the blue river!
Wow, the cargo yard! So many colorful boxes!
The little mail car carries letters for everyone!
Snack time! A warm bun from the platform cart!
Two trains wave hello! Toot toot, goodbye!
The waiting room is warm and cozy with big chairs!
From the lookout, what a wonderful view of the trains!
The sun is setting! Golden light on the shiny tracks!
Night is here! The lamps glow like little stars!
Wow, the big engine shed! The sleepy engines rest inside!
Hot, sweet chai from the little stall! Sip sip, so yummy!
The fluffy station cat is chasing butterflies! Come back, little friend!
The tall water tower fills the thirsty train! Glug glug glug!
Ding ding! The crossing gate comes down! Stop, wait, and smile!
Up the footbridge I climb! I can see the whole station!
Tick tock! The big clock in the clock room tells the time!
The parcel van is full of gifts! Maybe one is for me!
Shhh! The sleeper coach has soft, cozy beds!
In the goods yard, big cranes lift the heavy boxes high!
The ticket hall is bright and happy! Everyone is smiling!
Here comes the last train of the day! All aboard! Choo choo!
The sleepy train cars yawn, good night!
What a fun day! Bye bye, railway station! Vroom vroom!
Good morning, friends! I am Bella! Today I visit the big flower market!
Vroom vroom! Down the petal path I roll, toward the flower fields!
Wow, the tall sunflowers are smiling at me! Hello, hello!
The tulip rows are red and yellow, just like my paint!
The kind gardener fills my baskets with sweet roses!
Look! The market gate wears a crown of marigold garlands!
Inside, the stalls burst with every color! What a happy place!
Sweet jasmine flowers! Oh, how lovely they smell!
The tulip lady waves at me! One big basket, please!
Daisies, daisies! White like little clouds!
I deliver fresh flowers to the bakery auntie! Mmm, warm cake!
The fountain square sparkles with pigeons and petals!
Up the green hill I climb, past the old windmill!
The rainbow bridge sways above the blue river!
Flowers for the school kids! Look at those happy smiles!
The old clock tower rings! Ding dong, ding dong!
I rest under the big mango tree, breathing sweet air!
Butterflies dance around my mirrors! Whee, so pretty!
The flower parade float is so grand! Follow me, friends!
Petals fall like rain! What a lovely flower shower!
I carry garlands up the old temple steps!
Evening falls, and the lantern lane glows golden!
The boatman floats my flowers down the calm canal!
Fireflies light my way home! Twinkle, twinkle!
One last stop: fresh flowers for my best friend Rayo!
The moon rises over the sleepy village! So quiet, so calm!
Home at last! My garage smells of sweet flowers!
I dream of fields and colors and happy faces!
Good night, flowers! Good night, friends!
See you at the market tomorrow! Bye bye!

stories.title: Rusty and the Rainy Day Rescue

lines.t: Oh no! Who is calling for help in the rain? The river is rising — I must go!
My name is Rusty, and I am a strong tow truck — rain never stops me!
I splash through the big puddles — splish splash, what fun!
The wind pushes my hook left and right — hold on, hook!
There she is! A little blue car stuck in the deep mud!
Do not cry, little one. Rusty is here to save you!
I lower my strong hook — click! I catch your bumper gently.
Pull! Pull! Little by little — out of the mud you come!
Hooray! You are free! Let us get out of this cold mud.
Your tire is hurt. Climb on my back, little friend.
We drive home together — you are safe now, I promise.
Wait — what is that sound behind the big rock?
Oh wow! A family of little ducks is lost in the flood!
Climb on, ducklings! My truck bed is warm and dry.
The little blue car giggles — the ducklings tickle her windows!
Quack quack! They are singing a rainy-day song for us!
The sun peeks out — look, a rainbow over the hills!
Every cloud has a silver lining, my friends.
We drop the ducklings at their pond — home at last, little ones!
The blue car's mama is waiting — she hugs her baby tight!
Thank you, Rusty! You are the bravest tow truck in the rain!
My hook shines, my engine hums — helping friends feels so good!
The rain stops at last. The world looks fresh and clean!
Birds come out to sing — listen to their happy song!
We splash through the last puddles on the way home.
The little blue car waves goodbye — be careful in the rain!
Back at my garage, I hang my hook to rest.
What a day! Rain, mud, ducks, and brand-new friends!
I close my eyes and listen to the rain on the roof.
Tomorrow I will climb the great mountains — will you come with me?
Oh no! The mountain road is SO steep - can big Bruno really climb it?
Good morning, friends! I am Bruno, the big blue truck - and I never give up!
The little village needs these food boxes before sunset - vroom vroom!
My trailer is full of colorful boxes - fresh bread, fruits, and more!
First stretch: the sunny pine forest road - the tall trees wave at me!
Up, up, up! My strong engine climbs the rocky winding pass!
Careful now - the narrow cliff edge! Slow and steady wins!
Look, a waterfall! The cool mist dances on my windshield!
The mountain goats hop on the rocks - hello, funny goats!
I cross the old wooden bridge - creak creak, but it holds me strong!
The deep green valley opens below - what a big beautiful view!
Time for a quick rest - I park beside the wildflower meadow!
Wait - what is that tiny sound? Someone is calling for help!
Oh! A little lamb is stuck in the thorny bushes - do not cry, little one!
I push the branches gently with my strong bumper - you are free!
The happy lamb runs to its mama sheep - thank you, Bruno!
The kind shepherd waves at me - take these warm blankets to the village!
More boxes on my back - the village children will be so happy tonight!
Down we go - wheee! The snowy white slope sparkles around me!
Careful on the snow! My big tires grip the cold white road.
The frozen lake shines beside me - like a giant silver mirror!
Through the dark pine woods I roll - my headlights glow warm and bright!
Look! The little stone houses - the village is near!
The children run to meet me - welcome home, Bruno!
My trailer opens wide - food boxes for every family, one by one!
The village auntie gives me hot soup - slurp slurp, so yummy!
The shepherd's blankets warm every little house tonight!
The stars come out over the quiet mountains - twinkle twinkle!
I park under the big oak tree - my cozy bed for tonight!
Tomorrow I am going to the seaside - will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! My red beach ball rolled behind the big rocks - come on, Rayo, let's find it!
Good morning, friends! I am Rayo - look at my shiny red paint in the sunshine!
My tires love the soft warm sand - vroom vroom on the beach!
Look, tall palm trees waving their green leaves - hello, palms!
The little crabs run sideways - catch me if you can, crabby friends!
Splash splash! My wheels touch the cool blue water - so fun!
A colorful sailboat sails far away - bon voyage, little boat!
The fishermen pull their big net - wow, so many silver fish!
I race the seagulls along the shore - I am faster, wheee!
Oh look, pretty seashells in the wet sand - I will collect them!
The big rocks make a secret cave - what is hiding inside?
An old ship's wheel washed up on the sand! I wonder which ship lost it...
Wait - who is splashing out there? A dolphin is jumping!
Hello, Splash the dolphin! Can you jump high? Wow, amazing!
Splash found my red beach ball! Thank you, my new friend!
We play catch together - throw it high, Splash!
The old lighthouse shines its bright light - hello, keeper!
From the top of the cliff, the whole sea is blue and sparkly!
Time for a sandy picnic - yummy sandwiches by the sea!
A friendly turtle walks slowly by - take your time, little turtle!
The tide pools hide tiny starfish - so orange and pretty!
Look, a big ship sails to faraway lands - bye bye, ship!
The sky turns orange - the sun is going to sleep soon!
Pink and purple clouds - what a beautiful painting in the sky!
The surfers ride the big waves - wow, so brave!
Splash comes back to say goodnight - sleep tight, my friend!
The stars blink over the quiet sea - twinkle twinkle!
I park under the big palm tree - my cozy bed for tonight!
Goodbye, beach! Today was wonderful - tomorrow is a new adventure!
Tomorrow I will race through the desert - will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! The school bus has a flat tire - how will the children get to the pond?!
Good morning, friends! I am Bella - and I have a big idea!
Hop in, little ones! My seats are soft and my engine is ready!
Vroom vroom! Off we go, down the flower-lined road!
We sing our favorite song - la la la, all the way!
Look, the old stone bridge! It crosses the giggling stream!
Hello, tall sunflowers! You are taller than me today!
We stop at the duck pond - quack quack, the ducks say hello!
The children feed the ducks - little beaks go nibble nibble!
Splash! A duck shakes water on my shiny yellow paint!
The dragonflies zoom past - catch me if you can!
Wait - what is that floating in the pond? A tiny paper boat!
It carries a little note - 'Help! My kite is stuck!'
We follow the path to the big willow tree - look up!
There it is! A rainbow kite tangled in the branches!
I park very steady - climb up gently, little ones!
Got it! The kite is free - wheee, it flies again!
Its owner is a little boy - thank you, new friend!
Time for our picnic under the big mango tree!
Yummy sandwiches and sweet mangoes - my favorite!
A butterfly lands on my mirror - hello, tiny friend!
We play hide and seek in the tall grass - I am too big to hide!
The sun is getting low - time to pack up, little ones!
We wave goodbye to the ducks - see you soon, quackers!
Back on the road, the fireflies light our way!
The school gate glows warm - we made it back!
The children hug me goodbye - best trip ever!
I park in my cozy garage - what a happy day!
Good night, little stars - today was wonderful!
Tomorrow the village fair opens - will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! The village fair opens tonight — but all the lamps are dark! Who will light them up?
I am Rusty, the brown tow truck! My hook is strong and my heart is kind!
Vroom vroom! Down the dusty village road I go — clouds of golden dust behind me!
The mango trees wave at me! Sweet mangoes smell so good!
Look, the blue river sparkles beside the road! Little boats float by!
Up the small green hill I climb — I can see the whole village below!
The old banyan tree is so big! Birds sing in its branches!
Children wave from the schoolyard! Hello, little friends!
The village gate is painted bright red and gold! Welcome to the fair!
Wow! The fair gate is tall and colorful — flags flutter in the wind!
The ferris wheel is so big! It touches the pink evening sky!
Oh no! The big swing is stuck! The children cannot swing!
Do not worry! My strong hook will pull the swing gently!
Pull! Pull! Little by little — the swing moves again!
Hooray! The children swing high! Whee, whee, so much fun!
The sweet stall smells so yummy! Jalebis, laddoos, and warm milk!
I carry a big basket of sweets to the old grandmother! She smiles so wide!
The toy seller shows me a tiny wooden truck! It looks just like me!
The puppet show begins! The little puppets dance and sing!
Ding ding! The merry-go-round spins round and round!
Now the lamps! My hook lifts the big lanterns high, one by one!
Look! The fair glows golden — hundreds of little lamps shine!
Fireworks! Boom boom! Colors burst in the night sky!
The drum players beat so loud! Everyone dances in a happy circle!
I tow the tired little food cart home — it worked so hard today!
The moon rises over the quiet village! The fair lights twinkle!
Good night, little swings! Good night, sweet stalls!
My hook is tired, but my heart is so happy!
What a wonderful fair! I will remember this night forever!
Tomorrow I will help Bruno with his big night delivery — will you come with me?
Oh no! All the city shops are empty — the food boxes must reach them BEFORE sunrise! Can big Bruno make it in time?
Good evening, friends! I am Bruno, the big blue truck — and tonight I work while the city sleeps!
My trailer is full of fresh bread, milk, and fruits — vroom vroom, into the night!
First stop: the bakery on Flower Street — the baker is waiting at the door!
The street lamps glow like warm honey — what a pretty night!
Up the quiet hill road I climb — the city lights twinkle below like stars!
Look, a little owl hoots from the pine tree — hoo hoo, good night, owl!
I cross the old stone bridge — the river sparkles under the moon!
The night market square is quiet — the stalls sleep under their striped awnings!
Down, down into the sleepy old town — the cobblestone streets whisper!
Here is the toy shop! Little teddy bears wait for their boxes — here you go!
Wait — what is that tiny sound? A little kitten is crying by the fountain!
Oh! The little kitten lost her way home — hop on, little friend, I will help you find it!
We roll down the quiet garden lane — her mama might be waiting there!
Look, the park! The swings are sleeping under the silver moonlight!
We cross the little wooden bridge over the garden stream — almost home, little one!
The clock tower rings — ding dong, it is midnight already!
Wait — I know that little red house with the blue door! That is YOUR home!
Home at last! Her mama cat hugs her tight — thank you, Bruno!
Back on the road — the grocery shop needs its milk before dawn!
The farm road is quiet — the cows dream in the moonlit meadow!
I unload fresh milk at the corner shop — the shopkeeper smiles so wide!
The sky turns pink and gold — the sun is waking up!
The last stop: the flower shop on the river road — roses for everyone!
The river sparkles in the morning light — what a beautiful new day!
All the shops are full now — bread, milk, fruits, and flowers!
The city wakes up! Children wave at me — good morning, Bruno!
My trailer is empty and my heart is full — helping friends feels so good!
Time for a little nap — good night, stars, and good morning, sun!
Tomorrow I will cross the great desert with Rayo — will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! The desert wind blew my map away — how will I find the hidden oasis?
Hello friends! I am Rayo, the fast red race car — today I cross the great desert!
My tank is full and my wheels are ready — vroom vroom, into the golden sands!
The dunes roll like giant golden waves — wow, so big and so beautiful!
Look, a little desert fox runs beside me — hello, speedy friend!
The sun is so hot — I need shade, quick!
Up, up the rocky canyon road — my wheels grip the stones!
A cactus waves at me — hello, prickly friend, do not poke me!
The wind sings in the sand — shhh, listen, it sounds like a song!
I see a shiny lake — but it is not real! Tricky desert!
My wheels sink in the soft sand — push, push, Rayo!
Wait — who is that tall friend walking slowly in the heat?
It is Omar the camel! He knows every dune in this desert!
Omar says the oasis is behind the big red rock — follow him!
We pass a tiny desert village — children wave from the mud houses!
Omar shares his cool water — thank you, my tall friend!
Look — green palm trees ahead! The oasis is real!
Splash! Cool water at last — the oasis is the prettiest place ever!
Little desert birds sing for us — tweet tweet, welcome, Rayo!
I race around the palm trees — the cool breeze feels so nice!
Time to go — Omar waves goodbye with his long neck!
The sunset paints the dunes pink and orange — so beautiful!
Stars come out one by one — the desert night is so quiet!
A little owl hoots from a dry tree — good night, owl!
My headlights light the sandy path home — vroom, vroom!
I see the town lights far away — almost home, friends!
Home at last! My garage is warm and my bed is soft!
What an adventure — the desert, the camel, and the cool oasis!
Good night, desert stars — thank you for a wonderful day!
Tomorrow Bella visits a garden full of butterflies — will you come with us? Bye bye!
Oh no! All the butterflies have flown away — where did they go?
I am Bella, and I will follow the last little blue butterfly!
The rose arches are so pretty — I drive under them, vroom vroom!
Look, the sunflowers are taller than me — hello, sunny friends!
I stop by the little pond, and a frog waves from a lily pad.
A tiny bridge crosses the sparkling stream — splash, splash!
I cross the rainbow bridge, and colors dance on my yellow paint!
Wow, a whole cloud of butterflies is dancing in the meadow!
We drive past the tulip beds, and the tulips cheer for us.
The old willow tree gives us shade, and a ladybug joins our ride.
We drive through the orchard, where apples are shining red.
Wait — one tiny butterfly is crying. Her wing is hurt!
Don't worry, little one, I will take you to the Flower Doctor.
The Flower Doctor lives in a cozy cottage made of petals.
She puts a magic drop on the tiny wing — it sparkles like a star!
The little butterfly flies again! She spins a happy circle in the sky.
All the butterflies come back to thank me with a rainbow dance.
The butterflies teach me their secret dance — wiggle, spin, flutter!
I wiggle and spin with them, and the whole garden laughs.
A big orange butterfly lands on my mirror and tells me a secret.
The secret is a hidden garden behind the old stone wall!
We peek through the wall, and a thousand butterflies live there!
I plant a tiny seed there, so more flowers will grow for them.
The butterflies sprinkle golden dust on my seed — grow, little seed, grow!
The sun is setting, and the garden glows pink and gold.
The butterflies wave goodbye, and I wave back with my lights.
I drive home slowly, with a butterfly sleeping on my roof.
What a day — butterflies, flowers, and a brand-new friend!
Good night, little butterfly — thank you for a wonderful day!
Tomorrow Rusty will show me a snowy morning — will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! The whole town woke up buried in snow — who will clear the road before morning chai gets cold?
Good morning, friends! I am Rusty, the strong brown tow truck — snow never stops me!
Vroom vroom! Down the snowy village road I go — my tires crunch, crunch in the fresh white snow!
Look, the pine trees wear white hats — hello, snowy pines!
The frozen pond sparkles like a giant silver mirror — careful, do not slip!
Up the little snowy hill I climb — I can see the whole white village below!
The snowman by the school waves at me — hello, frosty friend!
Children throw snowballs — whee! One lands on my roof, plop!
I cross the old wooden bridge — the river sleeps under the ice!
The red postbox peeks from the snow — letters for everyone!
Down into the pine forest I roll — snow falls softly on my hook!
Wait — what is that sound? A little voice is calling from the snowdrift!
Oh! A little green car is stuck deep in the snow — do not cry, little one!
My strong hook pulls gently — pull, pull, out you come!
Hooray! You are free! Climb on my back, little friend, you are shivering!
We drive to the chai stall — hot chai for my cold little friend!
The chaiwala smiles — warm chai for everyone, on the house!
Sip sip! The chai warms us up — what a kind friend!
The little green car giggles — her wheels are warm again!
We build a snowman together — a carrot nose and a smile!
The snowman waves goodbye — thank you, Rusty!
I tow the chai cart to the town square — everyone needs hot chai today!
The town square glows with lanterns — children dance in the snow!
Snowflakes fall like soft feathers — what a beautiful white day!
The sun peeks out — the snow sparkles like diamonds!
I clear the road to the little school — children cheer, hooray!
Home at last! My garage is warm and smells of hot chai!
What a day — snow, chai, and a brand-new friend!
Good night, snowy town — thank you for a wonderful day!
Tomorrow Bruno sails to the harbour boats — will you come with me? Bye bye!
Oh no! The harbour bell is ringing — a little boat is lost in the fog! Can I help?
I am Bruno, the big blue truck! I carry help to the harbour, vroom vroom!
Look at the tall lighthouse! Its big light sweeps over the sea!
The wooden pier is busy! Boats bob up and down — hello, hello!
The fishermen mend their nets — what strong hands they have!
The cranes lift big boxes of fish — up, up, up!
The sandy beach is full of shells! I pick a pink one for my friend!
Ice, ice! The ice factory keeps the fish fresh and cold!
The old boat workshop smells of wood and paint — a new boat is born!
The ferry dock is full of happy people going home!
The fog is thick on the water — I must watch the road carefully!
Wait — what is that small sound in the fog? A little sailboat is calling for help!
Its engine is quiet! Do not worry, little boat — Bruno is here!
I hook my strong tow rope — click! Hold on tight, little boat!
Slowly, slowly — I pull you through the fog to the safe harbour!
Look! A baby seagull is lost on the little boat! Tweet tweet!
The baby seagull flaps its wings — its mama is calling from the lighthouse!
I lift the little boat gently — the baby seagull flies home! Hooray!
The fishermen cheer! The harbour is happy again!
The fish market square is full of cats — they smell the fresh fish!
The rope bridge sways over the blue water — careful, careful!
The glass-bottom boat shows me coral and fish below! Wow!
The sunset paints the sea orange and pink! So pretty!
The seafood lane smells yummy — the auntie gives me a warm bun!
The harbour master's tower blinks — all boats are safe tonight!
The anchor square has a big sailor statue — I wave hello!
The evening pier glows with lamps — the boats sleep softly!
The stars come out over the harbour! Twinkle, twinkle!
The moon shines on the calm sea — good night, little boats!
Tomorrow I will watch the big balloons fly with my friend Rayo — will you come with me?
Oh no! A big red balloon is floating away! Who will catch it?
Good morning, friends! I am Rayo! Today is Balloon Day at the fair!
Vroom vroom! Down the flowery meadow road I roll, toward the fair!
Look, the balloon field! So many round balloons, big and bright!
The basket man waves at me! Can I ride in a balloon one day?
The pink ticket booth is so happy! One ticket, please!
Sweet candy smells float in the air! Mmm, pink candy floss!
The big red balloon grows and grows! Hiss, whoosh, up it goes!
From the green hill, I can see the whole fair below!
Kites dance in the sky! Red, yellow, blue — whee!
By the little lake, the balloons shine in the water! So pretty!
Oh no! A small blue balloon is stuck in the tall tree! Help!
I drive to the orchard lane and ask the gardener for help!
The gardener gives me a long, soft rope! Thank you, friend!
Over the little rope bridge I zoom, to the tree I go!
In the village square, my friends cheer for me! We can do it!
Sunflowers nod their heads! You are so brave, Rayo!
Under the rainbow arch, I tie the rope to my bumper!
Pull, pull! The little balloon floats free! Hooray!
The balloon floats up to the clouds! Bye bye, little balloon!
The sunset paints the meadow gold! What a happy day!
Lanterns light the fair lane! The night fair is so bright!
By the riverbank, paper lanterns float on the water!
Through the pine forest I roll, the stars peeking through!
On the starry hilltop, I count the twinkling stars!
The moonlit fairground glows! The balloons sleep in the field!
Home at last! My garage smells of sweet candy!
Fireworks pop in the sky! Boom, boom, so pretty!
Good night, balloons! Good night, friends!
Tomorrow I visit the big river bridge — will you come with me?
Oh no! The big river bridge is closed — how will I reach the other side before the picnic starts?
Hello, friends! I am Rayo, the fast red race car — today I cross the great river bridge!
Vroom vroom! Down the pebbly riverbank road I roll — the water sparkles beside me!
Look, shiny fish are jumping in the river — hello, jumpy fish!
The old fisherman waves from his little wooden boat — good morning, friend!
Up the grassy hill I climb — I can see the whole river winding below!
The stone bridge is so old and grand — its arches sing in the wind!
Careful now — the wooden planks are wobbly! Slow and steady, Rayo!
From the middle of the bridge, the river looks like a big blue ribbon!
Look, white swans are gliding under the bridge — so graceful!
The bridge lamps are so pretty — they glow like little golden stars!
Wait — what is that tiny sound? A baby duck is stuck on a floating log!
Do not cry, little duck! Rayo is here — I will help you!
I honk my loudest horn — beep beep! The kind fisherman hears me!
The fisherman rows his boat to the log — hold on, little duck!
Hooray! The baby duck is safe in the boat — quack quack, thank you!
The mama duck swims over — she hugs her baby tight! Quack quack!
The duck family follows me along the river — my new friends!
Across the bridge at last — the other side is full of flowers!
The village children wave from the sunny square — hello, friends!
Time for a picnic by the river — yummy sandwiches and sweet lemonade!
A friendly frog hops onto my hood — ribbit ribbit, hello, little frog!
The waterfall sings behind the big rocks — splash splash, so cool!
I race the dragonflies along the river road — wheee, so fast!
The sun is getting low — golden light dances on the water!
The fisherman waves goodbye — see you soon, my river friend!
Back across the bridge — the lamps are glowing in the dusk!
The moon rises over the quiet river — twinkle twinkle, little stars!
Good night, river! Good night, ducks and fish and frogs!
Tomorrow Bella visits her friends at the zoo — will you come with us? Bye bye!
